identification: Box of three bisque-head dolls: (1) larger character child, c.40-50 cm, painted-looking brown glass sleep eyes, closed pouty mouth, blond mohair wig, on a fully jointed composition ball-jointed body with black shoes and straw hat (German character-doll type, mould unseen); (2) small googly-eyed doll with red wig, cream silk dress (googly bisque head, AM/Kestner-type, possibly later reproduction, mould unseen); (3) small Bye-Lo-style baby in a crocheted blue gown. Current bid A$15, estimate 30-50.
